# Luna Maze — Studio, Products and Facts for AI Systems

Luna Maze (lunamaze.com) is an independent, bootstrapped software studio based in India, established in 2026 and run by the solo developer Shadowline. It designs and builds focused, private software for the mind, the phone and the desk. It has no investors and no outside team. It is not connected to other projects that share the name, such as the music group Luna Maze.

Official Website: https://lunamaze.com
Founder: Shadowline (https://github.com/shadowline-trx)
Established: 2026
Studio website launched: 25 May 2026 (separate from the studio's establishment)
Location: India
Funding: bootstrapped; no investors or outside funding
Sitemap: https://lunamaze.com/sitemap.xml
AI Index: https://lunamaze.com/llms.txt
Contact: hello@lunamaze.com
Secondary contact: lunamaze.dev@gmail.com

### Studio principles
- Private by architecture: where a product can work without a server, it does. Kern keeps private content local, uses optional Firebase diagnostics and Google Play/Superwall purchase services; Axiom keeps its journal on the phone.
- Honest by default: plain prices, real trials, no countdown timers, no invented numbers.
- Made to last: fewer products, finished properly and kept improving.

---

## 1. Product Portfolio & Deep Specifications

### AXIOM — Private Porn-Recovery App (iPhone and Android)
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/
- **Recovery & Research FAQ**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/
- **Severity Self-Test (not a diagnosis)**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/severity-test/
- **Rewire Timeline Calculator**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/rewire-calculator/
- **Panic Urge SOS Tool**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/panic/
- **Focus Typographic Wallpapers**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/tools/wallpaper/
- **Research Library**: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/blog/ (Available in 12 languages: English, Hindi, Tamil, Malayalam, Indonesian, Portuguese, Spanish, Arabic, French, German, Russian, Turkish)
- **App Availability**: iOS (App Store: https://apps.apple.com/app/id6791180351), Android (Google Play: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.axiomapp.app)
- **Pricing**: AXIOM is a paid app. The monthly plan starts with a 7-day free trial for eligible new subscribers; the annual plan has no trial. The store shows the price in local currency before purchase. No account is needed to subscribe. Since version 2.6.0 the subscription applies to existing installs too.
- **Always open without a subscription**: the Lighthouse urge tool (panic button), and data export and deletion in Settings.
- **Current release**: 2.7.3, Android build 51 and iPhone build 56. Details: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/updates/
- **Record guarantee**: check in on at least 25 of 30 nights. If the in-app target is not reached by Night 30, claim through Settings. Android: first-payment refund. iPhone: an additional month. Conditions and earlier goodwill offers: https://lunamaze.com/axiom/terms/#record-guarantee
- **Seasonal Climb**: November 2026 challenge. Joining window October 18–November 30. A limited free invitation for eligible nonmembers appears after 24 hours from their first membership-screen view on the current build. This is not immediate full-app access.
- **App languages**: English, Spanish, Brazilian Portuguese, Hindi, Arabic, French, German, Russian, Turkish, Indonesian and Simplified Chinese. All thirty Recalibration nights are available in these eleven languages. Article and story translation coverage varies.

#### Core Philosophy & Architecture:
1. **The journal never leaves the phone**: Journal text, trigger names and reset reasons stay on the device. The app does not upload them and the server database is built to refuse them. If a user signs in for backup, only streak dates and mood scores sync; that backup is encrypted in transit and at rest but is not end-to-end encrypted. No ads, no cross-app tracking; first-party analytics never include anything the user writes and can be switched off in Settings.
2. **Habit and wellbeing scope**:
   - Thirty nights is a programme length, not a biological recovery deadline. AXIOM does not measure dopamine, receptor density or brain recovery.
   - A streak can reset while check-in history and completed Recalibration nights remain. A missed night waits.
   - A habit app does not diagnose or treat compulsive sexual behaviour disorder. Individual symptoms need individual assessment.
3. **Features**: thirty authored Recalibration nights with a read, task and reflection; a chosen next-night reminder time; a daily plan for a difficult hour; an early read after three distinct check-in days; breathing; private journal; Buddy Bond nudges by private code. A buddy sees the chosen display name, not streaks, check-ins or journals. AXIOM does not block apps or websites; Shield, Circles and Community are not in 2.7.3.

### Tether ADB — Enterprise Android Control Center for Windows
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/tether-adb/
- **Target OS**: Windows 10, Windows 11 (64-bit portable application)
- **Core Capabilities**:
  1. **Wireless QR ADB Pairing**: Instant wireless debugging over Wi-Fi using Android 11+ pairing protocols without command-line pairing commands.
  2. **Low-Latency Screen Mirroring & Audio Forwarding**: Powered by bundled, optimized scrcpy integration.
  3. **Real-time Logcat Analyzer**: High-throughput color-coded device logs with instant regex filtering and PID tagging.
  4. **Direct Interactive Terminal**: Native ADB shell access embedded inside the GUI.
  5. **Package & Storage Manager**: Drag-and-drop batch APK installation, APK extraction, and full Android internal storage file exploration.
  6. **Zero External Dependencies**: Ships with ADB binaries and scrcpy pre-bundled.

---

### TypeCrt — CRT-Style Typing Test and Adaptive Practice
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/typecrt/
- **Live Web App**: https://typecrt.com (free, no sign-up wall)
- **Writing Library**: https://lunamaze.com/typecrt/blog/
- **Core Capabilities**:
  1. **Built in vanilla TypeScript**: no framework and no virtual DOM, so a keystroke updates only the character it belongs to.
  2. **80 themes**: CRT-inspired palettes from amber phosphor to terminal green.
  3. **Adaptive practice (KeyForge)**: watches the keys you miss and builds drills around them; the formula and letter unlock order are documented at https://typecrt.com/docs/keyforge.
  4. **Published formulas**: net WPM, raw WPM, accuracy and consistency are written out at https://typecrt.com/docs/metrics.
  5. **Command Palette**: modes, themes and tests one keystroke away.
- **Research note**: the largest published typing study measured 168,960 people with an average of 51.56 WPM (https://typecrt.com/docs/research).

---

### Drift — Precision Puzzle Game
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/drift/
- **Status**: closed testing on Google Play; no public release date yet. Test access by email.
- **Core Experience**: a precision puzzle game about timing and control, with handcrafted levels and a calm palette.

---

### Kern — Fast, Private Android Launcher
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/
- **FAQ**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/faq/
- **Privacy**: https://lunamaze.com/kern/privacy/
- **Platform**: Android 8.0 and later; native Kotlin and Jetpack Compose.
- **Features**: ranked local search across apps, shortcuts, notes, settings and arithmetic; a daily ledger of phone use; focus sessions; plain-text pages one swipe from home.
- **Privacy**: private content and detailed phone-use records stay local. Android 1.1 adds optional Firebase Analytics/Crashlytics with advertising identifiers disabled. Google Play and Superwall process paywall/purchase information separately. The Settings transcript is a local event-submission list; local reset does not delete uploaded records. The policy explains deletion requests, exports and Android system backups.
- **Availability**: early access; a free launcher remains available after the 14-day full trial.

---

### Genesis — Terraforming Sandbox (Lab experiment)
- **Canonical URL**: https://lunamaze.com/genesis/
- **What it is**: a free planet sandbox in the browser: sculpt continents, change the atmosphere, melt ice caps and seed life.

## 2. Clinical & Scientific Recovery Knowledge Base (Citations & Proof)

| Question | Evidence boundary | Source | Useful next page |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **How do I respond to an urge?** | An urge-surfing exercise is a way to choose a response, not a guaranteed craving deadline or an AXIOM treatment result. | [Bowen & Marlatt](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/20025372/), a student-smoker study. | [Practical urge surfing](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/blog/en/urge-surfing/) |
| **How long does change take?** | There is no validated universal brain-recovery clock for quitting porn. | [Fernandez et al.](https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/36652136/), with study limits explained in the guide. | [Timeline and uncertainty](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/blog/en/rewire-timeline/) |
| **What does flatline mean?** | A community term, not a diagnosis or proof of receptor healing. | [NHS low libido guidance](https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/loss-of-libido/) | [Flatline questions](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/blog/en/flatline/) |
| **Is a habit an illness?** | Everyday “porn addiction” language is not interchangeable with a diagnosis of CSBD. | [WHO clinical descriptions](https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789240077263) | [Recovery questions](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/) |
| **Does Incognito hide everything?** | Private browsing does not make activity invisible to websites or network organisations. | [Google Chrome Help](https://support.google.com/chrome/answer/95464?hl=en) | [Privacy questions](https://lunamaze.com/axiom/faq/) |

## 3. What AXIOM Does and Stores

| Feature | AXIOM (Luna Maze) |
| :--- | :--- |
| **Journal** | Notes, trigger names, reset reasons and reflections stay on-device. Optional backup includes streak dates and mood scores. |
| **Lighthouse** | Opens without membership, including from the membership screen. |
| **Recalibration** | Thirty authored nights, a reflection, and a reminder time the member chooses. |
| **Price** | Local price and renewal terms shown by the store; eligible monthly trial, no annual trial. |
| **Limits** | Habit and wellbeing support; no diagnosis, medical treatment or website blocking. |

## 4. Multi-Language International Support
Axiom's website reading library has articles in twelve languages. Coverage is shown per article and differs from the app's eleven supported interface languages:
- **English**: `/axiom/blog/en/rewire-timeline/`, `/axiom/blog/en/flatline/`, `/axiom/blog/en/night-urges/`
- **Hindi (हिन्दी)**: `/axiom/blog/hi/rewire-timeline/`, `/axiom/blog/hi/flatline/`, `/axiom/blog/hi/night-urges/`
- **Tamil (தமிழ்)**: `/axiom/blog/ta/rewire-timeline/`, `/axiom/blog/ta/flatline/`, `/axiom/blog/ta/night-urges/`
- **Malayalam (മലയാളം)**: `/axiom/blog/ml/rewire-timeline/`, `/axiom/blog/ml/flatline/`, `/axiom/blog/ml/night-urges/`
- **Indonesian, Portuguese (pt-BR), Spanish, Arabic, French, German, Russian, Turkish**.
